pages.title: Dilaton Crystal
pages.text: In string theory, the dilaton is a field whose value sets the string coupling: how readily strings split and join. This crystal froze one value of it. Hold it up to the light and everything behind it looks slightly more or less substantial.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found these growing on the Graviton Reefs of the Bulk and inside the Calabi-Yau Knot. Their facets responded to string interactions, and I realised they had frozen the dilaton field in place.

Made in $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Dilaton Ore$(), in veins through the Bulk.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Calabi Yau Knot chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Singularity, String Coupling Crystal.
